# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 with refreshed rendering fixes and updated native text shaping. RAW and DNG image decoding is no longer included, and GLES interop now uses pointer-based signatures. Review these changes before adopting the preview.

## Breaking Changes

- **RAW and DNG decoding removed** — RAW and DNG image decoding is no longer available. Convert those assets to a supported format before decoding them with SkiaSharp. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))
- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — GLES interop now uses pointer-based signatures. Update native interop call sites to pass the expected pointers. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m155** — Refreshes the bundled renderer with Skia m155 and its servicing fixes. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196), [#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## API Surface

- **GLES interop signatures modernized** — Native GLES interop now accepts pointers, aligning the bindings with the underlying API. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — Removes support for decoding RAW and DNG images from the bundled native library. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz text-shaping engine to version 14.4.0.
